  • install_requires contains NlpToolkit-Math-Cy and NlpToolkit-Util-Cy; the provided data does not establish sudden malicious dependency insertion or dependency-confusion behavior.

Additional Review Needed

  • Large dictionary data files were only partially represented or listed by name, so full artifact inspection is needed to completely rule out embedded payloads.
